_meta.note: 一個故事一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Ruins of Detlas#001.src: You read an entry in the worn journal...
Ruins of Detlas#001.dst: Lees una entrada del diario desgastado...

Ruins of Detlas#002.src: A stranger came into town today all the way from {p}. {p} of all places! What do the folk there want with us in this small town?
Ruins of Detlas#002.dst: Hoy ha llegado al pueblo un forastero desde {p}, nada menos. ¡De {p}, precisamente! ¿Qué querrá la gente de allí de nosotros, en este pueblecito?

Ruins of Detlas#003.src: It's nothing but farmland for as far as the eye can see around here. I want some excitement! I want to go to {p} and see the castle there!
Ruins of Detlas#003.dst: Por aquí no hay más que tierras de cultivo hasta donde alcanza la vista. ¡Quiero emociones! ¡Quiero ir a {p} y ver el castillo de allí!

Ruins of Detlas#004.src: Then again, the roads are more dangerous now than they ever have been. If rumors are to be trusted, you can't step three feet out of town without running into an undead
Ruins of Detlas#004.dst: {c1}Aunque, por otro lado, los caminos están más peligrosos que nunca. Si hay que creer los rumores, no puedes dar tres pasos fuera del pueblo sin toparte con un no muerto.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#005.src: Who knows, maybe this'll all blow over soon...
Ruins of Detlas#005.dst: Quién sabe, quizá todo esto pase pronto...

Ruins of Detlas#006.src: That trader from {p} was saying some disturbing things the other day.
Ruins of Detlas#006.dst: {c1}Aquel comerciante de {p} contó el otro día cosas inquietantes.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#007.src: He mentioned that the undead attacks are growing more frequent all over Wynn. Even {p} is straining under the pressure.
Ruins of Detlas#007.dst: {c1}Dijo que los ataques de no muertos son cada vez más frecuentes por todo Wynn. Incluso {p} está sufriendo la presión.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#008.src: {p} has managed to avoid the worst of the scourge. But how much longer will our luck last?
Ruins of Detlas#008.dst: {c1}{p} se ha librado hasta ahora de lo peor de esta plaga. Pero ¿cuánto más nos durará la suerte?{/}

Ruins of Detlas#009.src: It's been unusually quiet these past few days. I don't like it. Even for a small town such as {p}, there is such a thing as being too quiet.
Ruins of Detlas#009.dst: {c1}Estos últimos días ha estado todo inusualmente tranquilo. No me gusta. Incluso en un pueblo pequeño como {p}, se puede estar demasiado tranquilo.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#010.src: I fear the rumors of the increasing undead roaming the lands. What's worse, there are other rumors saying that they are being led by a human.
Ruins of Detlas#010.dst: {c1}Me dan miedo los rumores de que cada vez hay más no muertos vagando por estas tierras. Y lo que es peor, otros rumores dicen que los guía un humano.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#011.src: What madman would turn against their own kind in favor of... those things?
Ruins of Detlas#011.dst: {c1}¿Qué clase de loco se volvería contra los suyos para ponerse del lado de... esas cosas?{/}

Ruins of Detlas#012.src: I just hope I can keep my people safe. Wait, I fear something approaches..
Ruins of Detlas#012.dst: {c1}Solo espero poder mantener a salvo a mi gente. Espera, me temo que algo se acerca...{/}

Ruins of Detlas#013.src: The book is torn in half. The rest of the entry must be somewhere nearby...
Ruins of Detlas#013.dst: {c1}El libro está partido por la mitad. El resto de la entrada debe de estar por aquí cerca...{/}

Ruins of Detlas#014.src: The pages are torn and are black with soot on the edges. You read the rest of the entry...
Ruins of Detlas#014.dst: {c1}Las páginas están rotas y tienen los bordes negros de hollín. Lees el resto de la entrada...{/}

Ruins of Detlas#015.src: This may be my final entry. The human leading the horde is no human. He is tainted. Broken. Controlled.
Ruins of Detlas#015.dst: {c1}Puede que esta sea mi última entrada. El humano que guía a la horda ya no es humano. Está corrompido. Roto. Controlado.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#016.src: Fire spreads from his hands like magic.. If only we had such power. Someone has to stop this. Alas, it can not be me. He is here.
Ruins of Detlas#016.dst: {c1}El fuego brota de sus manos como si fuera magia... Ojalá tuviéramos un poder así. Alguien tiene que detener esto. Por desgracia, no puedo ser yo. Ya está aquí.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#017.src: I was talking to Mary the other day. She said some of the survivors are planning to make the trip to {p} or {p}.
Ruins of Detlas#017.dst: {c1}El otro día estuve hablando con Mary. Me dijo que algunos de los supervivientes piensan hacer el viaje a {p} o a {p}.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#018.src: She asked me if we should go with them. I told her we we're staying here. The road to {p} is too dangerous, and {p} is too far away.
Ruins of Detlas#018.dst: {c1}Me preguntó si deberíamos irnos con ellos. Le dije que nos quedamos aquí. El camino a {p} es demasiado peligroso, y {p} está demasiado lejos.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#019.src: But as the night draws near, I'm not sure about my decision...
Ruins of Detlas#019.dst: {c1}Pero ahora que se acerca la noche, ya no tengo tan clara mi decisión...{/}

Ruins of Detlas#020.src: This journal is opened to an entry dated {~} AP. You begin to read it...
Ruins of Detlas#020.dst: {c1}El diario está abierto por una entrada fechada en el {~} AP. Empiezas a leerla...{/}

Ruins of Detlas#021.src: There aren't that many left in this town. If this place can even be called a town.
Ruins of Detlas#021.dst: {c1}Ya no queda mucha gente en este pueblo. Si es que a este sitio se le puede llamar pueblo.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#022.src: There's me, Hank, Mary, their kids, the Mayor who's crazy now, Andy, Steve, and Judy and her kids.
Ruins of Detlas#022.dst: {c1}Estamos yo, Hank, Mary, sus hijos, el alcalde, que ahora está loco, Andy, Steve, y Judy y sus hijos.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#023.src: We only have enough for about a day or so. We have no choice: we need to leave for a fortress.
Ruins of Detlas#023.dst: {c1}Solo tenemos para un día, más o menos. No hay otra opción: tenemos que marcharnos a una fortaleza.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#024.src: Andy, Steve, and I will lead. The road to {p} is difficult. If you read this, I hope {p} still stands.
Ruins of Detlas#024.dst: {c1}Andy, Steve y yo iremos delante. El camino a {p} es difícil. Si lees esto, espero que {p} siga en pie.{/}
